document.about: Federal Reserve Financial Stability Report, April 2024. Pages 26 and 27 set the body column beside charts set one under another, whose scales stand a few points from the column's edge, each stepping at its own pitch.

checks.issue: #431: a tick of each chart's scale cut the paragraph it stood beside; the column's scales together did not step evenly, so none was read as a scale.

element.text: to emerge. For example, the 12-month trailing corporate bond default rate moved up further, on net, since the October report and stood near the median of its historical distribution. Expectations of year-ahead defaults remained

checks.issue: #431: the scale's ticks were scattered through the paragraph.
#431: two of the scale's ticks were read as one line, the rest one by one.
